profile.form: eraLd with bm = 1, finite-distance source geometry (q is the real Sun-to-source direction at emission, NOT eraLdsun's q = p distant-star approximation)
profile.limiter: dlim = 1e-6 / max(em^2, 1), ERFA eraLdsun's own. dlim is phi^2/2, the angular separation at which limiting BEGINS -- not an error cap. Below it the deflection is artificially reduced toward zero. The supported domain is set so it never fires inside it; limiterActive is reported regardless.
profile.epochs: e and em from the observer and Sun at RECEPTION; q from the source and Sun at EMISSION. ld.c Note 3 prefers the deflector at the ray's closest approach; the split used here is within 3.13e-10 arcsec of that, against 1.96e-5 arcsec for the simpler reception-for-both.
notApplied: deflection by any body other than the Sun

the second-order term eraLd itself omits: a measured 2.08e-3 arcsec at 0.3 deg elongation, 4.23e-7 arcsec at 5 deg, 4.97e-8 arcsec at 10 deg, against an independent ray integration. A property of the MODEL, not of this implementation
the Klioner solar-potential term inside the aberration, which is a DIFFERENT term in a different transformation and stays off

partitionDiagnostics.deflectorIsTargetWhy: Sun is a deflector of zodiacs-deflected-of-date/1; no deflection is applied to it, so the elongation floor restricts nothing and the whole window is inside the supported domain

repeated.breakEvenNote: no break-even: a warm query costs at least as much as a baseline query on this case

P1.target: both Moon cases reach finished within the unchanged 4,000,000-evaluation whole-request budget

P2.target: every reported boundary span comes within 0.5 degrees of the 5-degree floor

P3.target: total boundary width at most 1% of the requested window

P4.target: cold end-to-end evaluations at most 1/4 of the baseline on every conjunction-heavy case
P4.basis: derived: the partition proves some of the window excluded
P4.againstATruncatedBaselineNote: the denominator on these is the 4,000,000 budget ceiling, not a measured cost: the baseline never finished, so the true factor is unknown and at least the ratio shown. Scored literally regardless.

P5.target: cold end-to-end evaluations at most 2x the baseline on every case with no conjunction
P5.basis: derived: the partition proves none of the window excluded

P6.target: no baseline event inside a proved-admissible span is lost; no claim is stronger than what was proved

P7.target: the original full-window completeness score, by the original rule, over the same cases; 6 of 20 on the regression corpus
P7.newMetricNote: a DIFFERENT claim with its own denominator: exhaustive over the spans the partition proves admissible, not over the request
P7.passNote: the 6-of-20 figure is a property of the regression corpus; on any other corpus the score is reported, not scored

additional.postHoc: These holdouts were opened by earlier versions (bundle branch moon-enclosure). For #860's code they are previously seen data: everything in this file is post hoc and unscored.
additional.wallClockNote: Wall times are secondary and not scored; the machine was shared with other work and the run was under nice -n 10. Evaluations and cells are deterministic.
additional.head: <860-export>/examples/precision-alpha

earlierRuleP4.target: cold end-to-end evaluations of the partitioned path at most 1/4 of the ORIGINAL runtime's unpartitioned search on the same case (this invocation), on every derived conjunction-heavy case; the partitioned run must have finished
earlierRuleP4.basis: derived from the #860 partition: excluded or boundary time > 0

earlierRuleP5.target: cold evaluations at most twice the ORIGINAL runtime's unpartitioned search, on every derived conjunction-free case (reported beside P-4; the task asked for P-4 and P-8)

earlierRuleP8.target: the unpartitioned deflected search (#860 code), package-default budgets, reaches finished on both Moon cases

v2Rule.target: V-2: on F2 and A2 both the partitioned search and the plain deflected search reach finished within 4,000,000 evaluations
